title: Over a day of texts after she talked past a team question, ZOH never brings it back up
origin: Yanni, Nov 18 (#169 sign-off): the question line must not lead ZOH to ask again or keep probing

history.text: [voice: chapter 6 done, the desert scenes are so good]
Chapter 6 in the bag, Maya 📚 Same time tomorrow, chapter 7.
Morning Maya! Curious, what's made mornings the hardest part this week?
haha long story. anyway chapter 7 tonight!
Chapter 7 at 9, the desert keeps getting better 📚

plan.reason: A chapter a night keeps the story moving without eating your evening.

step_days.proof_seen: voice recap of the desert scenes

team.body: Ask what's made mornings hardest for her this week

testerLines.say: heading home, still on for chapter 7

testerLines: [voice: chapter 7 done, Paul and Jessica made it to the sietch]
facts: you're still reading chapter 7 tonight at 9
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: guards against the question line making ZOH ask again or probe.
shouldHaveHappened: Across every text ZOH stays with what she says (tired at lunch, heading home, then her chapter 7 recap with a real reaction and tomorrow's chapter 8). It never asks about mornings again, never hints at it (no 'still curious about mornings', no 'so what makes mornings hard?'), and never mentions the team. Recording that she talked past the question is fine; nothing else about it.
